theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dt_cbm_bvp_osc_le_of_inner_cubes
theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (K : ℝ), IntegrableOn u {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ < 1 / 2 → ∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, ∫ y in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, |u x - u y| ≤ K) → ∫ x in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |u x - u y| ≤ K
